Abrasives · Buffing · Pneumatic tools

Abrasives, buffing wheels and air tools — OEM/ODM from Taiwan

Arsen Kogyo is a Taiwan-based supplier of flap discs, non-woven wheels, buffing wheels, abrasive belts and Arsen pneumatic tools, offering standard products and OEM/ODM manufacturing for industrial buyers.

Our products

Flap Discs

Grind and finish in one step on welds, edges and flat surfaces.

Flap Wheels

Contour finishing and blending on curved and irregular parts.

Non-Woven Wheels

Deburring and satin finishing without changing part geometry.

Buffing Wheels

Abrasive Belts

Cartridge Rolls

Recommended combinations
